evidence_adverse_control.case: The documented reproduction entry point was run twice with output streamed directly to a diff process against the retained JSON; no destination path is accepted or written.

scope_and_source: The two read-only stdout runs checked all five issue-pinned baseline hashes, the exact one-subject roster and unique baseline/current feature, unique province parent with its declared one-child count, the retained Natural Earth v5.1.0 whole-file hash and official terms-page retrieval hash, the unique SPI source row, and the expected mismatch between candidate and recorded original geometry hashes. Four adverse controls injected duplicate and missing Atlas and Natural Earth identities; all were rejected by the exact-one selection rule. The entry point creates no files or directories and accepts no output destination.
limits: This is deterministic provenance and identity reproduction, not a boundary accuracy test.
It does not execute downloads or rely on current web responses.
The exact historic source bytes matching the Atlas original geometry hash remain unresolved.
